method: Union rig frames sharing a retained landmark. Include every model frame as a vertex, including unsupported isolated frames. Camera-to-frame assignments use the frozen S/F manifest for atlas output and explicit COLMAP frames.txt DATA_IDS for the control; never infer COLMAP frames from image-ID arithmetic.

pose_boundary_diagnostic.interpretation: Pose discontinuities coincide with the lost connectivity boundary and a nearby interval; source geometry and pose-owner provenance must establish cause before any correction is selected.

source_bridge_trace.loss_stage: Final atlas-pose triangulation, after successful observation ownership merging
source_bridge_trace.counting_caveat: Follow-up DSU audit confirms the 31 source point rows remain 31 distinct merged tracks; this does not imply 31 geometrically valid anchors.

source_track_connectivity.method: Reusable independent PINHOLE auditor with frozen rig manifest; large within-owner pose steps do not correspond to disconnected source landmark graphs.

pose_owner_audit.interpretation: The 1999/2000 cut changes owner, but the jumps at 1997/1998 and 2022/2023 occur within a single owner. A rigid displacement of the entire later component cannot explain all three discontinuities.

split_track_dlt_audit.method: Split each unique merged crossing track at frame 1999/2000; apply existing endpoint-inclusive maximum-64-sample DLT and full-observation positive-depth, minimum-two-observation, mean <= 2 px and max <= 4 px gates independently on each side. No GT.

decision: All 4,999 atlas frames have observation support, but two output files do not prove the same landmark connectivity as COLMAP. The 31 unique crossing tracks survive merging but fail atlas-pose triangulation. Test bounded resection candidates with existing GeneralizedPnP using independently triangulated left-side anchors, then measure cross-track recovery and existing support loss before any adoption. No whole-component pose shift, scoring realignment, GT-based selection or threshold relaxation.
